text:
Sam: Morning team small alert 1 mug of melted chocolate found glued to the toaster hood. Who's the chocoholic? :chocolate_bar:
Jo: omg that was me  apology, reheated a chocolate croissant and it escaped. I wiped the worst but missed the top. I'll deep-clean it at lunch.
Priya: please also check the kettle lid  it's been rattling and the strainer is gone. Someone borrowed it?
Arun: I borrowed the strainer yesterday for tea and forgot to return it  leaving it on my desk now. Sorry! Kettle seems fine to me but I'll check the lid tonight.
Sam: can we have a mini rule: if you use the toaster/oven pull out the crumb tray and empty weekly? small step saves sticky disasters.
Jo: agree, I'll add a tiny note by the toaster: "EMPTY CRUMB TRAY IF USED" and put a spare strainer in the STOCK box.
kitchen-bot: Inventory scan complete. Low items: instant coffee (1), sugar (2), paper towels (2). Recommended: restock instant coffee.
Priya: thanks KB. If anyone wants to be on crumb-tray duty this week, say "me". I'll coordinate next week's rota.
Arun: me
Sam: me (can swap if someone needs)
Jo: thanks all, cleaning now and bringing small brush for crumbs later. :broom:
